purpose: Choose exactly one deterministic, no-fit Alpha158 conditional return-magnitude mechanism for Campaign300 without reading Campaign300 candidate values, comparator values, daily prices or forward returns.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_conditional_return_magnitude_asymmetry_20d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Alpha158 freezes SUMP20 and SUMN20 as positive and negative absolute close-change shares and CNTP20 and CNTN20 as positive and negative session frequencies. Dividing each share by its matching frequency produces scale-equivalent typical up-session and down-session magnitudes; their normalized upside share isolates conditional first-moment payoff asymmetry instead of raw direction frequency or total gain-loss balance.

parameters.valid_input_rule: all four inputs finite; SUMP20 and SUMN20 nonnegative; CNTP20 and CNTN20 strictly positive; both conditional magnitudes finite and nonnegative; their sum strictly positive; resulting score finite in [0,1]; never fill, clip, winsorize, threshold, rank, sign, absolute-value or add an epsilon
parameters.economic_hypothesis: When a stock's typical up-session close change is larger than its typical down-session close change after controlling for their occurrence frequencies, asymmetric upside information assimilation may persist from the next accepted open through the third accepted close.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_conditional_return_magnitude_lower_direction
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Negating the selected score or preferring lower values would create a two-direction search. The higher normalized upside-magnitude share is frozen once.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_conditional_return_magnitude_horizon_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Trying the available 5, 10, 30 or 60 session variants, pooling horizons or selecting a best horizon would create a horizon search. One conventional twenty-session month is frozen.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_conditional_return_magnitude_transform_threshold_or_epsilon_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Logit, ratio-minus-one, signed difference, absolute value, square, clipping, winsorization, thresholds, buckets and epsilon repairs are discretionary variants and are excluded.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_raw_sump_sumn_sumd_or_count_balance_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Raw SUMP20, SUMN20, SUMD20 or CNTP20-CNTN20 measures aggregate direction balance or frequency rather than conditional magnitude. Campaign295 already uses SUMD20 inside price-volume confirmation, so these raw refreshes are not independent.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign299_close_distribution_retune_reverse_rehorizon_transform_or_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign299 is immutable and terminal. Campaign300 does not use MA, QTLU, QTLD, close-level distribution tails or the Campaign299 output, and does not combine any terminal factor.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign295_price_volume_confirmation_retune_or_combination
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign295 is immutable and terminal. Campaign300 uses no volume or CORD20 and does not read or transform Campaign295's SUMD20*(1+CORD20)/2 output; the frozen raw Alpha158 coordinates remain admissible only as an antecedent complete research library.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign298_volume_cv_or_campaign296_beta_rsqr_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign300 uses neither volume dispersion nor fitted beta/R-squared trend linearity and does not retune, reverse, transform or combine those terminal factors.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: alpha158_peer_rank_state_multi_horizon_or_extreme_arrival_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign290-294 already consumed peer-state and cross-horizon geometry, while earlier terminal campaigns consumed extreme-arrival order. Campaign300 applies one within-stock conditional first-moment formula and no peer transform.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: supervised_model_random_feature_weight_subset_or_terminal_factor_combination_search
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Earlier model campaigns consumed fitted and randomized model families. Campaign300 contains exactly one deterministic weight-1 factor, no terminal-factor combination and no training-return read.
